title: Unified Inference: Product Overview, PRD & Roadmap Q4 2026
author: Ava Chen
content:
Overview
========

Short intro
-----------
This document consolidates the product overview, high-level PRD, design guidance, roadmap themes for Q4 2026–Q2 2027, pricing and packaging notes, and release notes for the Unified Inference product suite. Intended audience: product, eng, sales, solutions, and customer success.

Goals and success criteria
--------------------------
- Goal: Provide a single product narrative for Unified Inference that aligns engineering priorities, GTM messaging, and pricing for predictable revenue expansion.
- Success metrics (12 months):
  - 30% increase in Dedicated deals referencing Unified Inference features
  - 20% reduction in average per-token cost for 50% of customers using Optimize recommendations
  - 99.95% platform uptime for hosted inference (SLA target)

Product scope summary
---------------------
- Redwood API (hosted): stable REST/SDK surface, streaming, function calling, model catalog.
- Redwood Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, autoscaling policies, SLA-backed latency.
- Redwood Private: VPC/on-prem installs with optional audit logging and KMS integrations.
- Redwood Console & Optimize: observability, cost controls, quantization profiling, rollout tooling.

High-level PRD (summary)
=======================
Problem statement
-----------------
Teams building LLM features need predictable latency and cost while retaining flexibility to move workload to Dedicated or Private deployments as they scale. Current friction: inconsistent SLA guarantees across deployment modes, limited packaging options for mixed-hosted + dedicated customers, and fragmented billing visibility.

User stories
------------
1. As an ML engineer, I want per-route latency and cost breakdowns so I can tune routes for production SLAs.
2. As a platform engineer, I want to pin model versions and rollout canaries across Dedicated and Hosted uniformly.
3. As a procurement lead, I want clear pricing tiers and committed capacity plans that align with usage patterns.

Key requirements (MUST / SHOULD / MAY)
-------------------------------------
| id | requirement | priority | owner | acceptance criteria |
|----|-------------|----------|-------|---------------------|
| PR-01 | Unified API parity across Hosted, Dedicated, Private | MUST | Eng-Platform | Customers can swap deployment targets without code changes; SDK tests pass end-to-end |
| PR-02 | Per-route token & latency breakdown in Console | MUST | Eng-Platform | Console shows token counts, cost estimate, p50/p95 latency per route for last 7 days |
| PR-03 | Rollout policies (canary/A-B/fallback) | MUST | Eng-Platform | Canary traffic split and automatic fallback on error rate > 2% |
| PR-04 | Pricing tiers: Pay-as-you-go, Reserved Monthly, Enterprise Commitment | SHOULD | Product | Billing supports blended rates and committed discounts |
| PR-05 | Optimize suggestions engine (batching/quant) | SHOULD | Applied-ML | Recommender suggests config with projected cost delta and safety guardrails |

Design & architecture notes
==========================
Service boundaries
------------------
- Control plane: model catalog, billing, console UI, rollout orchestration (hosted).
- Data plane: inference runtime (low-latency), batching, KV cache, quantized kernels.
- Bridge: Dedicated & Private agents that connect customer clusters to the control plane over mTLS.

API contract (example)
---------------------
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
Body (JSON):
{
  "model": "redwood-unified-v2",
  "input": "<prompt>",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "route": "default"
}

Response (streaming compatible): chunked JSON objects with token metadata including token_cost, kv_hit boolean.

Quantization and kernel selection
--------------------------------
- Model profiles: store per-model recommended quantization profile (int8/int4) and expected quality delta (A/B evals).
- Runtime chooses kernels based on sequence length histogram and selected quant profile.

Operational constraints and SLOs
===============================
- Hosted API availability SLO: 99.95% monthly.
- P95 latency target: < 250ms for small-context (<=128 tokens) models on production SKU.
- Incident severity policy: Sev1 — platform outage impacting >10% of customers; aim MTTR < 60 minutes.

Roadmap & themes (Q4 2026 – Q2 2027)
====================================
Themes by quarter
-----------------
- Q4 2026 (now): Stabilize Unified API parity, GA pricing tiers, Console per-route cost.
- Q1 2027: Dedicated autoscaling policies v1, canary rollout UI, Optimize alpha for batching.
- Q2 2027: Private deployment GA, enterprise commitment contracts, advanced Optimize (quant recommendations + simulation).

Milestones & high-level timeline
--------------------------------
1. 2026-10-15: Pricing & packaging public docs (beta customers).
2. 2026-11-20: Console per-route cost & latency GA.
3. 2027-01-31: Dedicated autoscaling pilot with two anchor customers.
4. 2027-04-15: Private deployment GA for regulated customers.
